cause_quote: The new cron restore path passed `snapshot: source.snapshot` to `restoreGatewayOperatorSource`, which rejected the saved source whenever `generationOwner.requiredGeneration !== snapshot.sharedGeneration`.
user_saw: After a proxy admission setting changed, the next run of an automation created from a proxy-signed-in chat was refused and the automation was disabled.
summary: Saved proxy-authenticated automations now revalidate the creator’s access grant without requiring an exact match on the proxy admission hash.
reasoning: The introducing diff added saved operator authority for scheduled continuations and routed each occurrence through the existing exact-generation check. At that commit, trusted-proxy sessions already saved a generation that hashed required headers, so changing those headers could invalidate a saved automation even while the creator’s grant remained valid. The Enterprise upgrade exposed the same failure by changing the rendered proxy configuration.
